chat.t: My minion! Answer my summons!
This is an emergency! I need your help!

o: Help? What did you mess up this time?

chat.t: No! I haven't done anything!
Why do you always assume it's my fault?!

o: Well, after what happened the other day...

chat.t: Th-That was different!
Back then, it was to save the world!
That has nothing to do with this!

o: *Sigh*... Whatever. What's going on?

chat.t: The Destiny Staff of Solitary Fate has vanished!

o: What even is the Destiny Staff of Solitary Fate?

chat.t: The legendary Magic Tool I always carry with me!

o: Oh, that ridiculously huge IV stand?

chat.t: It is not an IV stand! It is the Destiny Staff of Solitary Fate!
Never mind that! Get over here at once!
You traitor! Dummy! Meanie!
You're a disgrace to minions everywhere! May divine punishment strike you down!
How dare you abandon me in a room I cannot leave until I eat all the bell peppers!!!

o: What kind of room is that supposed to be?
Well, you found your IV stand and ate your peppers. Two birds, one stone.

chat.t: That's not two birds with one stone, you dummy!
My taste buds have already been cursed!
If you wish to save me, bring me melon custard pudding tomorrow!
If you do not, I shall inflict the curse of bell peppers upon you as well!!!

o: Is that something a pharmacist should be saying...?

lines.t: A few days after the unprecedented disaster in Humanitas had passed...
Saverim B1F
...Why did you call me to a place like this?
My minion! What took you so long?!
Do you know how long I've been waiting?!
*Sigh*... Hey, Rana the Brat.
H-Huh...? R-<bouten>Rana the Brat</bouten>?
I came all the way here because you asked for help, and this is the attitude I get?
You must've forgotten what I'm like... Do you need me to set you straight today?
A-Alright! I'm sorry! I was wrong!
Just p-please don't do that!
See, you can behave when you try. Let's keep it up from now on.
H-Hmph... What's gotten into my minion...?
You weren't like this a thousand years ago...
You keep going on about a thousand years ago. Does that honestly make any sense to you?
So you've been this tiny for over a thousand years?
...Kukuku. Minion, I am not tiny.
This form is merely a side effect of sealing away the Primordial Apocalypse.
A side effect?
Hmm. You did say your memories haven't fully returned yet, didn't you?
You remember, surely? A thousand years ago, we joined forces to seal away the Primordial Apocalypse.
...Did you say that? I don't really remember...
Hmph! I told you! We sealed away the apocalypse and saved the world together!
Saved the world, huh? Sounds like I was a pretty big deal a thousand years ago.
Kukuku. It was no easy feat. The Primordial Apocalypse was far more fearsome than we'd imagined...
Sealing it away came at a price. For both of us.
A price? What did it cost you?

We did everything we could to prepare for the final battle, but...
we were still just a little short on power.
In that desperate moment, I had one last resort: take part of the apocalypse into myself and seal it in my left eye.

I blacked out. When I awoke...
all my power was gone, and I looked like this.
...Ah, right... What a tear-jerking story...
But is now really the time for playing pretend like this?
...Ah! That's right! We don't have time for this!
My minion! The Destiny Staff of Solitary Fate has vanished!
I've been looking everywhere, but I can't find it!
That staff is my other half! It's been with me since we fought the apocalypse! We must find it!
No idea, but have you checked upstairs?
Actually, why did you have me come to the basement instead of the first floor?
Hmm... Y-You think so too...?
My minion... The truth is, I can't go upstairs right now.
So I must ask a favor of you! Go up and look for it in my place!
I mean, I can do that, but... what do you mean you can't go up?
...You're not slacking off again, are you?
I am not! And what do you mean, 'again'?! When have I ever slacked off?!
...Ahem! The thing is... I didn't eat my bell peppers, and Sophia caught me...
Argh, stop looking at me like that! Everyone has something they can't stand!
So basically, you dumped your 'other half' just to dodge some bell peppers?
H-Huh?! I-I... Th-That's not...!
*Sigh*... Just come with me. You know your IV stand better than I do.
I'll keep watch when we go up, so hurry up and grab it in the meantime.
...Kukuku. You have my gratitude, my minion.
And it's not an IV stand. It's the Destiny Staff of Solitary Fate. Don't get it wro—
Ah! W-Wait for me!
Saverim 1F
...Looks like no one's around. Come on, hurry up.
...Huh?
Kukuku... Impressive, my minion. You slipped past Sophia so easily...
More importantly, look over there.
Isn't that it? The thing you were looking for?
Ooh! Destiny Staff of Solitary Fate!!
Kukuku...! I can feel my power returning!
Wait a second, something's off. For it to be sitting right out in the open like this—
Hehe, that's right. It's a trap to catch Rana!
There you are, Rana. I've been waiting for you.
Ngh...! S-Sophia set a trap?!
My minion, this is an emergency! We must escape at once!
...*Sigh*, give up. We're already completely surrounded.
Whaaat?!
You left your staff behind, so I kept it safe for you.
But before you can leave, Rana, you'll have to eat every last bell pepper.
Whaaaaaat?!
All this drama over bell peppers...
M-My minion! There must be some way out of this!
You helped me seal the apocalypse...! Surely you have a plan to get us out of this!
...*Sigh*. Guess I have no choice.
Kukuku! I knew I could count on my minion! Sophia, your scheme was clever, but he saw right through—
Stop being so picky and eat your vegetables. No wonder you're so short.
Huh?
Well, you have your IV stand back. I'm off.
You t-traitooooor!!! Don't leave me here, you big meanie!

chat.t: My minion! Answer my summons!
This is an emergency of the highest order! The highest!

o: What did you do this time?
Slacking off? Running from your bell peppers again?

chat.t: Why do you always assume I've done something wrong?!
Do you have any idea how hard I worked today?!
I've been volunteering at the clinic all day! Since this morning!

o: Then what's this huge emergency?

chat.t: Ahem...
Th-This is top secret! The fate of the world hangs in the balance!
It's far too dangerous to discuss over an unsecured channel like this!

o: You're making a fuss over nothing again, aren't you...?

chat.t: No! This is extremely important!
Never mind that! Get over here at once!
I shall tell you the details once you arrive!!!!

o: Hey, you make it back okay?

chat.t: You meanie! Dummy! Evil jerk!

o: Calm down. I was just teasing you back there.

chat.t: How was that supposed to be a joke?!
I saw the look in your eyes when you chased me!

o: I was just acting to make it more fun.
I figured you could use some fun after all that volunteer work.

chat.t: Liar!!! I won't be fooled!!!

o: Alright, alright. I'll buy you some pudding as a peace offering.
Can I head over to Saverim now?

chat.t: Hmph... Very well.
Bring at least ten. And get different flavors!
Meanwhile, I shall hide the Destiny Record of Solitary Fate somewhere safe.

o: Sharp little thing, aren't you...?

lines.t: Humanitas Park
Kukuku... Welcome, my minion.
Alright, what's got you bouncing around this time?
...A-Ahem! Lower your voice, my minion!
This place is beyond my barrier! Stay on your guard!
What are you on about now...? And why are you alone? Where are Sophia and Eileen?
Kukuku. Sophia and Eileen are at Saverim.
I've been going around the city, volunteering to help treat people.
Volunteer work? Isn't that what they make you do as community service?
Did you get caught slacking off? Or was it for refusing to eat bell peppers again?
No! What do you take me for?!
I came to see whether anyone was still suffering from what happened the other day!
Oh... That's actually pretty good of you.
...Kukuku. Now do you understand? Such is the duty of one destined to walk alone!
I merely did my duty. Ku, ku, ku...
Yeah, yeah. Anyway, didn't you say something about an emergency earlier?
...Ahem. Indeed. My minion, do you not see it?
Can't you tell my usual commanding presence is gone?!
...? Pretty sure you didn't have any charisma to begin with.
Hmph! Stop joking around and take a proper look!
I mean... you can't even see something like that in the first place.
Grr... Th-Then here! Look right here!
Doesn't something look different?!
Hmm... Beats me.
My Destiny Record of Solitary Fate! I always have it with me, and now it's gone!
...? What on earth is...
How the heck was I supposed to notice that, you idiot?!

Wait, so you made all this fuss about an emergency and losing charisma
just because you lost another book?
Ngh...! I-It's not just a book! It's the Destiny Record of Solitary Fate!
A forbidden book of prophecy, holding the knowledge we need to hunt the Curse of Ruin!
It is a supreme treasure whose secrets ordinary minds cannot hope to comprehend!!
So what you're saying is you lost your "supreme treasure" somewhere again?
H-Huh...? Th-That's not...! N-No! Well, yes, but...!
B-But I've been rushed off my feet volunteering all morning!
*Sigh*... Well, that's a better excuse than when you lost your IV stand.
Anyway, you lost that record thingy somewhere around here, right?
A-Ahem... Correct. I've already checked everywhere else.

And, my minion, it's not an IV stand. It's the Destiny Staff of Solitary Fate,
and it's not a record thingy—
Just lead the way already.
Ah! W-Wait for me!
Park Walkway
—Kukuku... And so, a thousand years ago, we saved the world from the Primordial Apocalypse.
And so began a lonely destiny... remembered by no one... Ku, ku, ku.
...Right. You've really thought this whole apocalypse backstory through.
Hmph! My minion, I've told you! It's all true!
Actually, I'm curious. You said we sealed the apocalypse away together a thousand years ago, right?
Then what happened to <bouten>me</bouten> after that?
Huh?
Kukuku. It was no easy feat. The Primordial Apocalypse was far more fearsome than we'd imagined...
Sealing it away came at a price. For both of us.
You said we both paid a price. You lost your powers sealing it away...
So what happened to me? Did I lose my memory?
A-Ahem...

Are you sure you didn't mistake me for someone else?
I haven't even been in this town for that long.
That is not true! There is no way I would mistake you for anyone else!
...W-Well, it had been so long that I didn't recognize you right away, but...
Anyway, so what happened to me then?
W-Well... I don't know either.
Don't look at me like that! By the time I woke up, you had already vanished!
...K-Kukuku. Surely you made a sacrifice of your own to stop the apocalypse...
...That's it? You just went your separate ways right then and there?
You saved the world together, then just called it a day? Some partnership.
Of course not! I kept looking for you!
It's just that... I couldn't find a single trace of you anywhere in the world, so at some point I gave up...
O-Oh... I see. I didn't know...
(How much of this is she making up...?)
...Kukuku. And yet, after a thousand years, we meet again...
Our fates are truly inseparable!
Yeah, sure... Let's go with that.
More importantly, isn't that your book over there?
Ooh! My Destiny Record of Solitary Fate!!
Hmm, it's heavier than it looks.
So this is your supreme treasure, huh? I wonder what's written inside—
Aaaaaah!
Gaaah!!!
You scared the life out of me!! What's your problem?!
You mustn't look! This is forbidden knowledge!
One glance could drive an unworthy mind mad in seconds!
How is that a treasure then?! Why are you carrying around something so dangerous?!
O-Of course... Th-That's it! I'm keeping it safe so no one gets hurt!
Some job you're doing! You nearly got me killed!
Ngh...! I-It's fine! If that happens, I'll give you medicine to restore your sanity!
Seriously?! "Go ahead and lose your mind, I've got medicine for that"?!
Man... I almost met my doom for the most ridiculous reason ever...
...M-My minion. That's not what I meant—
Come on. Who am I? Your minion, that's who.
Hmm? Y-Yes...?
Then... let me see what's in there!
Aaaaaah!
N-No means no! Even for you, you stubborn jerk!
Don't lie. It's written all over your face. Let me guess...
You've been writing nasty things about me in there, haven't you?
...Huh?
...Y-You dummy! W-Why would I write nasty things about you?!
Anyway, I will NEVER show you!! No matter what!!! NEVER!!!
Ah! Hey, where are you going?!
Just one page! Let me look at just one page!!
Aaaaah! Somebody help me!
*Pant, pant*...! H-How is she so fast?!
(In the end, I didn't get to see a single page.)

chat.t: My minion... It's an emergency...
Please... save me...

o: Again...?
You sound different, though. Is something actually wrong this time?

chat.t: I've been busy for days on end...
I haven't been this busy since the lethargy incident...
If I work any more, I am going to die...

o: Well... should I buy you some pudding or something?

chat.t: Kukuku... My minion.
Pudding can't save me.
Only you can do that.

o: Refusing pudding? This really is an emergency.

lines.t: (I headed to Saverim to save a life before it was too late.)
Saverim
(She wasn't kidding. This place is packed...)
(But why? I thought the lethargy and all those rampages were over.)
Huh?
<:player>! Ehehe, hi!
What brings you here...? Oh, did Sophia call you?
No, Rana asked me to save her.
Whaaat?! Have you seen Rana?! Where is she?!
I just got here. How would I know?
Wait, are all these people patients? Why are there still so many?
Oh! Most of them are probably here for their shots!
Everyone seems back to normal after the lethargy scare... but we can't be sure yet!
Some people might still have symptoms, so Sophia says we need to keep checking on them for a while.
Shots? Really...? Wasn't it all caused by your pudding and some random drink?
Not our pudding! Rana's detox pudding!
...Did you just throw her under the bus?
Oh, right! Rana! {player}I'm looking for her right now!
She started saying weird things about bell peppers tasting like sweet pudding, then vanished!
Yeah, I think I heard something similar last time.
Oh! Do you know where she went?! We've still got tons to do!
Hmm... I have an idea.
I'll find her and bring her back. You hold down the fort, Eileen.
Ehehehe, you got it! I'm counting on you!
Saverim B1F Hallway
...Not here?
I was sure she'd be hiding in that room again...
...Wait, did this brat break my house window again?!
*Rattle*—!!
I think... I hear something.
—nion...!
*Sigh*...
—My minion...!
*Sigh*... All right, I'm coming.
My miniooon...!
...What are you doing?
(After that, I used the slippery medicine to get Rana out.)
Ugh... I feel so gross...

Oh... it really makes your skin slippery.
Fascinating.

Hmph!
S-Stop messing with me!

M-More importantly, my minion!
W-Why did you drink my medicine?!

A-And... r-right there...
Ngh!

Well...
You said it was for drinking. Didn't want to waste it.
...Seriously, why did you make medicine like this?

Ahem! I told you!
To be ready for any <bouten>emergency</bouten>!
What kind of emergency?

Have you forgotten already?!
The <bouten>Innate Barrier</bouten> that Sophia cast before!
Innate Barrier...? You mean when Sophia used your IV stand as bait?
Kukuku... I still remember that helpless feeling... Captured, with no choice but to eat bell peppers...
But! In that helplessness, I found a great truth...!

No matter how bad things get...
as long as I can run away, what's the problem?
...*Sigh*, just eat your bell peppers...

Ku, ku, ku!
Since then, I've always kept medicine on hand to escape from Sophia!
The slippery medicine and the one that makes me run faster work especially well. Kukuku...

...Medicine that makes you run faster?
Wait a minute...

Kukuku. Indeed.
You know better than anyone how well that one works...

That revelation led me to create a masterpiece that can bend fate itself!
Kukukuku!
Oh, and it's not an IV stand. It's the Destiny Staff of Solitary Fate!
...Did I even call it an IV stand?

*Sigh*... Just come with me.
Eileen says you've still got a lot of work to do.
Huh?

Ugh...
W-Why can't I bend fate enough to get out of work...?
Oh, that reminds me...
Why were you so desperate to hide that diary?
...Huh?
All that talk about hunting curses and a book of prophecy... It was just a diary.

Aaah!
W-Wait! Earlier...!
W-Why did you look at that, you big dummy!!!!
It was just a picture diary. What's there to be embarrassed about?
Actually, there was someone who showed up next to you a lot—

Aaaaaah! N-No!
Forget you saw any of it!
That was the Bunny Girl we saw at the Casino during that pudding incident, wasn't it?
...Huh?
There was a bit where someone was chasing you, too.
Weren't those the same women who came charging after us, screaming, "Catch those terrorists!"?
They had the same scary looks on their faces, too.

But why did you draw that Bunny Girl so often...?
Wait, do you have a thing for Bunny Girls—
My minion.

Uh, yeah...?
What is it?

*Sigh*...
Forget it.

...?
What's with you?

chat.t: Kukuku... At last. The day has come...
It has been a long, long wait... Kukuku...
Now I shall break free from my twisted fate and reach a new truth...!
Kukuku! Kukukuku!
My minion...?

o: Huh? What?

chat.t: ...Kukuku. We must have had a bad connection.
Clearly, my message didn't get through. Allow me to repeat myself.
As of yesterday, I've escaped the hell of endless work!
In other words, I'm free! Kukuku! Kukukuku!

o: Right, congrats. Must be nice.

chat.t: Hmph! You could at least sound happy for me!
Anyway! I have a job for you today!

o: A job? What kind?

chat.t: Kukuku. I'll explain when I see you...
Stay where you are! I'm coming over!

o: Sure, sure.
Ah, hold on, don't come in through the window again, alright?
Hello??

lines.t: Hideout
Kukuku. Pardon the intrusion.
It has been quite a while since I last visited your lair.
Phew, at least my windows survived today.
I'm in a good mood today, that's why. Ku, ku, ku...!
Those hellish days felt almost as if I were facing the Primordial Apocalypse...
Hm? Wait, so breaking my window when you came in before was—
Ahem! My minion, this is no time for such trivial matters.
The <bouten>fate of this worldline</bouten> may well depend on the job I bring you...
Right, here we go again.

Ku, ku, ku!
But first, my minion, take this.

This is...
a theme park day pass?
Kukuku. It came into my possession after I cleansed a curse the other day.
...A-After all, I owe you for finding my treasure.

Th-This is just to thank you!
Don't read anything else into it!

Oh... Since when are you so sweet?
Thanks anyway.

Anyway, you said you had a job for me.
What is it?

Ahem...
W-Well, you see...

T-Today,
I'd like to hire you... as my escort.
An escort...?
Ahem. You remember how I've been hunting curses for days on end.

Fortunately, it ended without incident, but...
as a result, my spiritual energy has been completely drained.
If I do nothing, the <bouten>remnant of the apocalypse</bouten> sealed in my left eye will break loose again...

In short...
I must replenish my spiritual energy by any means necessary!
So... you've worked yourself to the bone, and now you want to let loose?

N-No!
This isn't about having fun! It's about the seal!

Sure, sure. You're due for some fun.
Work hard, play hard, right?
...Wait, this escort job...

Ahem! Listen!
I chose that place for a reason!
A theme park is a massive domain where the joy and vitality of countless souls swirl together...
Where better to restore my depleted spiritual energy?!

...Huh?
A theme park?

...Oh, you want me to go with you?
So that's what the tickets are for.

Huh...?
W-What did you think I meant?
You know... buy you pudding, eat your bell peppers, carry your IV stand, give you a piggyback ride. That sort of thing.

You big dummy!
What do you take me for?!

R-Right. My mistake.
Calm down.
Anyway, consider yourself officially escorted. Let's get going.

Grrr!
Get back here!
(A short while later...)
Theme Park
Kukuku... Just as I'd heard! This place is overflowing with energy!
With all this energy, I could do more than recover my powers. I could reach a whole <bouten>new realm</bouten>!
All this fuss, and you've already been here for the cooking contest...

Hmph!
I didn't get to have any fun that time!

Today, I'm staying until closing and having all the fun I want!
Don't try to stop me!
See? You ARE just playing around.
My minion, that's not the point.

Ku, ku, ku... Now, choose!
What shall we ride first?!

Personally, I was thinking bumper cars...
Ahem. That merry-go-round looks promising too...

*Sigh*...
You really don't get it, <bouten>shorty</bouten>.
Huh?
Naturally, we start with this.

Ugh...
A-Are you serious...?
Wait, does that thing even count as a ride—
This should be a piece of cake for the great savior who sealed the apocalypse, right?

You're not...
scared of it, are you?

...K-Kukuku, Kukuku!
Of course not!
<bouten>I</bouten> was only worried that starting with this would make everything else seem boring!

Oh, feeling confident?
Let's see you prove it.
Aaaaaaaaaargh—!!!!!!
Aaaaaaaaah!
Ghaaaaaaaaah—!!!!!!!
Save meeeeeee—!!!!!!!
Ughhh... Th-The sky... is spinning...
Bleurgh... I-I'm gonna die... That thing's a death trap...
K-Kukuku... My minion... so weak... Kukuku...

You... laughing at me...?
Let's go again— Urgh...!
DD STATION MINI

Ku, ku, ku...
A DD STATION inside the theme park, too...

This must be destiny. Kukuku.
Who am I to deny it?
You came all the way to a theme park just to play arcade games?

Ahem!
Now, let us see what lies inside the claw machine here—

Ahhh!
My minion! Look at this!

*Sigh*...
What is it now?
<bouten>A gift card for a fancy gourmet pudding shop!</bouten>

And there's only one left!
It's destiny!
Right, feels like I've seen this somewhere before.

My spiritual energy is still far too low...
Only you can do this!
Now, break this accursed seal and set my treasure free!

Why is it your treasure?
If I win it, it's mine.
Huh?

Ahem... Kukuku— Kukuku...
Better luck next time, my minion.
Don't let it get you down. Kukuku... Kukuku...!
One more time!!!

Phew, is it that late already...?
Should we start heading back?
Ugh... I-I'm still fine...!

Today... we keep having fun!
Until we drop!

You don't look fine at all...
Forget it, let's go.

Awww!
But there are still so many rides we haven't been on...!
Look, there's no way you can ride everything here in a single day anyway.
We can just come back next time. Next time.

...N-Next time?
Will you... come with me again...?

Yeah, yeah, so let's go.
If you actually fall asleep here, you'll be too heavy to carry back.
Carry me...?

Hey! Give me a piggyback ride!
I can't walk!

*Sigh*...
You're killing me...
(I ended up giving her a piggyback ride home.)

chat.t: Y-your baaack...
it's sooo warm... Kukuku...

o: Seriously?

chat.t: this is fun... Kukuku...
riiight? Kukuku...

o: What's so fun about texting me when I'm carrying you...?
Don't drool on my back.

chat.t: I diiidn't drool!

o: *Sigh*...

chat.t: Kukuku. My minion.
You served me well as my escort today.
I shall call on you again. Often. Kukuku...

o: Right, I'll think about it.

chat.t: Huh?
Wait, didn't you say so yourself?
You said you would never leave my side!

o: That was what YOU said.

chat.t: No!!!! You definitely said it!!!!!
I heard it myself!!! It's true!!!!!
Reallyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy

o: Ugh, fine, I get it!

chat.t: Kukuku. A promise is a promise.
I've already taken a screenshot.

o: I said I'll think about it!
Wait, was this your plan all along?

lines.t: Saverim
*Pant, pant*...! W-We're here...!
Oof...  Alright, Rana the Brat. We're here. Wake up.
Huh...?  Wh-Where... are we...?
Where else? Your house. Come on, wakey-wakey.
Oh, {player}hello!
Oh, you were with Rana? And...
My, you're carrying a lot... Is all that Rana's?
Yeah, we spent the day at the theme park.
See this teddy bear? Won it in just five tries. Not as easy as it looks!
...I-Is that so?

I mean, I did get it in five tries, but it's no big deal.
It looks big, but it's not that hard once you actually try.
Just watch the claw carefully. The moment it starts to swing, you hit the button—
Mmm... So sleepy...
Hey, don't forget this giant teddy bear I won for you. In five tries.
Hmm?  Mmm...
...A-Ahaha. Sounds like you two had a wonderful time.
I'm glad those tickets I gave her went to good use. Hehe.
Huh...? Wait, you were the one who gave her those tickets?
That's right. She's had a lot on her plate since that whole lethargy scare.
She's been talking about it for days. This morning, she was up much earlier than usual... Hehe.
...You sure have your hands full.
Not at all. She's a sensitive soul, and she doesn't open up easily. I was a little worried...
Hehe. I never expected her to come right out and ask for something.
A sensitive soul...? Who are we talking about, exactly?
Haha, really!  I've known her for a long time.
{player}When she's with you, she seems to let her guard down and relax a little.
It's obvious how much you mean to her...  At least, it is from where I'm standing.
...Is that so? I can't really tell...
Hehe. You really are two of a kind. Neither of you knows how to handle your feelings.
...Two of a kind?
Now then, {player}I have a favor to ask.
Could you stay with Rana for a little while?  I've still got some work to finish.
Just until she's sound asleep.  Please?
...*Sigh*. Alright. I can do that.
Honestly... She's a handful even when she's asleep.
Hehe. ♪ Take good care of Rana for me, won't you?
...She's already out like a light.
Mmm... *Mumble, mumble*...
...Hmm?
Did you sleep well?
Aaaaaaaaaah!
Rana's Room
Wh-Why are you in here!?!?
I came to check on you. You were half asleep, and I figured you'd start leaving your stuff everywhere again.
Especially that teddy bear I won in five tries. You've got to take care of—

Argh!
